script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. OFFICE - DAY

JANE (30s, ambitious, hardworking) stands at her cubicle, organizing her desk. She's focused, determined, yet visibly tired.

Suddenly, her boss, MIKE (40s, stern, fair), appears behind her.

MIKE
(looking concerned)
Jane, you've been working non-stop for the past week. You need a break.

JANE
(sighs)
I know, but the project deadline is fast approaching.

MIKE
(understanding)
I understand, but you can't do it all alone. Your team needs you to rest so we can all perform at our best.

Jane hesitates, then nods.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - LATER

Jane sits alone at a table, drinking coffee and browsing her phone. A soft knock on the table catches her attention. She looks up to see ROB (30s, kind, compassionate), a colleague she's never been particularly close to.

ROB
(smiling)
Hey, I saw you were here on your own. Care to join me for a coffee?

Jane hesitates, then nods. They sit down together, engaging in small talk.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

Jane and Rob work together late into the night, sharing ideas and laughter. They bond over their shared love of their work and their mutual frustration with the demands placed on them.

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - NEXT MORNING

Jane lies in bed, staring at the ceiling. She hears a knock on her door. It's Rob, bearing a tray of breakfast.

ROB
(smiling)
I thought you might be hungry.

They sit down to eat together, chatting about their lives outside of work.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

The team gathers around to discuss the progress of their project. They all share their successes and challenges. Jane, feeling refreshed and inspired, shares her ideas with enthusiasm.

MIKE
(impressed)
This is exactly the kind of collaboration I had in mind.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

Jane and Rob sit across from each other, enjoying their coffee. They talk about their dreams and aspirations, and Jane confesses that she's always felt a little lonely at work.

ROB
(reassuring)
You don't have to be alone, Jane. We're all here for each other.

Jane smiles, feeling a sense of relief and gratitude.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

The team works together in harmony, their progress on the project impressive. Jane's energy is contagious, and her colleagues are inspired by her newfound enthusiasm.

INT. MIKE'S OFFICE - END OF DAY

Mike sits at his desk, looking at the reports on his desk. He notices Jane's improved performance and the team's newfound camaraderie.

MIKE
(to himself)
This is exactly what I wanted.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

The team celebrates the completion of their project, their smiles and laughter echoing through the office. Jane looks around at her colleagues, feeling a sense of belonging and gratitude.

FADE OUT.
